# Overview

Data, technology, and marketing teams at PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC are actively involved in managing pipeline and customer acquisition reporting activities. These teams work with multiple interconnected processes spanning data management, reporting, and analytics to support the business’s lead management and asset tracking objectives.

The current operational environment leverages several core systems, including Salesforce and Tamarac for client and portfolio data, Azure Blob Storage for data storage needs, and both Microsoft Fabric and Azure Synapse to handle data processing and analytics workloads. Power BI serves as the primary reporting suite, enabling the development and delivery of business intelligence dashboards and reports. QuickBooks has been identified as an additional data source, with ongoing efforts to integrate it more closely into the data ecosystem.

Data from Salesforce, Tamarac, Azure Blob Storage, and QuickBooks forms the basis for existing reporting activities. The organization’s cloud infrastructure centers on Microsoft Fabric and Azure Synapse, providing the foundational platforms for current and planned data management and analytics operations. An outstanding integration focus involves connecting and ingesting data from QuickBooks and addressing the associated data quality assessment required for more comprehensive customer acquisition cost reporting.
